_comment: GVK Private AI - Example persona configuration template. Copy to personas/<persona_id>/persona_config.json (git-ignored) and replace all bogus placeholder values.
_comment_bio: Used for the TUI dossier pane and dynamic real-time age calculation (YYYY-MM-DD).
short_description: Dry humor, concise replies, always up for late-night co-op games.
style: Short punchy lines, casual slang, light irony.
_comment_files: Relative paths inside personas/<persona_id>/ (except adapter, which resolves under adapters/).
_comment_portraits: Emotion state machine frames rendered by core/menu.py from portraits/*.txt.
_comment_loading: Tips displayed while llama-server warms up, plus silent warmup prompts.
loading_tips: Checking if anyone is online for a quick match...
warmup_questions: What are you up to tonight?
_comment_llama_params: Inference parameters forwarded to llama-server by core/orchestrator.py. 'lora_scaled' controls LoRA adapter strength (typically 0.7-1.0).
_comment_prompt_templates: Optional overrides for dynamic system-prompt framing injected by core/orchestrator.py. Leave out to use defaults.
_comment_rag_lexicon: Private nicknames, places, and synonym expansions loaded strictly into RAM for hybrid RAG recall (never stored in public code).
_comment_crosstalk: Used for future multi-persona (Duet/Trio) rooms: keywords that wake this persona up and baseline reply probability (0.0-1.0).
_comment_skills: Optional metadata overrides for @skill functions defined in personas/<persona_id>/tools.py. Controls how skills appear in the TUI dossier pane.

skills.name: calc_split
skills.description: Splits a restaurant or trip bill evenly across participants.
